title: A selected state needs a 3:1 mark, not only a light tint
rule: When rows or items can be selected (multi-select lists, trees, grids), mark every selected item with something that reaches 3:1 against an unselected one in every theme and preview surface — a solid `--fm-accent` bar or border, not only a translucent tint (a 16% accent tint is about 1.3:1). The focus ring on the cursor item does not count: it marks one item, not the selection. Add a Playwright check under both color schemes that selects items away from the cursor and computes the ratio from the computed colors.
rationale: E5.2 (#65): the font list marked selected rows only with a 16% accent tint (≈1.27:1 light, ≈1.32:1 dark); only the cursor row had a ring, so a multi-selection was unreadable for low-vision users (WCAG 1.4.11).
